title: Craftia-Recall
description: Adds several weapons and gameplay-friendly structes.
body:
# **_Craftia - Recall_**
 (in the latest 1.03 alpha version):
1. Adds over **_[12]_** Craftable Weapons into the Game! 
2. Adds **_[6]_** Surface ruins Structures _(doesn't contain any loot.)_
